crew.original_title: ドラゴンボールZ 龍拳爆発!!悟空がやらねば誰がやる
crew.overview: The Z Warriors discover an unopenable music box and are told to open it with the Dragon Balls. The contents turn out to be a warrior named Tapion who had sealed himself inside along with a monster called Hildegarn. Goku must now perfect a new technique to defeat the evil monster.
crew.title: Dragon Ball Z: Wrath of the Dragon

details.biography: Hideki Inoue (井上 英紀, Inoue Hideki) is a Japanese animator, director, animation director and character designer, who has been mainly active in Madhouse and satellites. He had been in Studio Live for many years from the video era to recent years, but now seems to have left the company.
details.name: Hideki Inoue
